biomes.name: Forest
biomes.description: Woods and plantations: bark, leaf litter and the dark under the canopy.

biomes.name: Scrub
biomes.description: Thickets, heath and thorn: dry, tangled and sunlit.

biomes.name: Town
biomes.description: Streets, roofs, gardens and park ponds: where most people are.

biomes.name: Snowfield
biomes.description: Permanent snow, glaciers and the cold water at their edges.

biomes.name: Open Water
biomes.description: Lakes, rivers, reservoirs and the sea.

biomes.name: Mangrove
biomes.description: Tidal forest: roots, mud and brackish water.

biomes.name: Tundra
biomes.description: Moss, lichen and bog pools on cold open ground.

species.name: Tarn
species.description: A dark fish with a red belly from the cold tundra lakes.

species.name: Sedge
species.description: A small, furry brown butterfly that flies low over the bog.

species.name: Ribbon
species.description: A dark eel with lines of green light running the length of its sides.

species.name: Pepper
species.description: A stout sandy gecko with dark bands, out at dusk among the thorn bushes.

species.name: Twig
species.description: A slim brown skink that suns itself on fallen logs.

species.name: Lark
species.description: A sky-blue lark that sings while hanging high over open grass.

species.name: Verdigris
species.description: A deep green dragonfly ringed with light, seen over bog pools in the short summer.

species.name: Clink
species.description: A shiny teal beetle often mistaken for something dropped on the pavement.

species.name: Nettle
species.description: A striped spider that strings its web between bramble stems.

species.name: Jet
species.description: A long-legged spider from sheds, cellars and stairwells.

species.name: Soot
species.description: A small black bat that roosts in attics and hunts round the lamps.

species.name: Mesa
species.description: A sickle-winged swift that nests in canyon walls and never seems to land.

species.name: Regent
species.description: A raven with a violet sheen that is said to know the hour without the bells.

species.name: Dune
species.description: A black beetle that drinks the fog from its own ridged back.

species.name: Aurelia
species.description: A golden songbird with trailing plumes, heard at first light and almost never seen.

species.name: Umber
species.description: A brown bat that leaves its hollow tree as the light goes.

species.name: Cinder
species.description: A dark skink banded like cooling lava, with a sail that glows at night.

species.name: Juniper
species.description: A green butterfly with long tails, seen where sun reaches the forest floor.

species.name: Barley
species.description: A busy striped bee working along the crop rows.

species.name: Brocade
species.description: A white koi splashed with red, grown old in a city fountain.

species.name: Shiver
species.description: A jelly of clear ice-blue that drifts under the pack ice, glowing faintly.

species.name: Drizzle
species.description: A brown snail found on walls and flowerpots on wet mornings.

species.name: Boreal
species.description: A great white owl flecked with blue light, the quiet keeper of the ice.

species.name: Prism
species.description: A butterfly with wings like clear glass, their veins lit from within.

species.name: Marble
species.description: A dark frog whose spots shine green on moonless nights.

species.name: Ceres
species.description: A hare the colour of ripe wheat that farmers count as luck for the year.

species.name: Tawny
species.description: A pale-faced owl that roosts in barn rafters and hunts the field edges.

species.name: Sickle
species.description: A cream moth with glowing crescents, on the wing only at harvest.

species.name: Nibble
species.description: A tiny golden mouse that climbs wheat stalks with its tail.

species.name: Peep
species.description: A small brown finch that flits from thicket to thicket.

species.name: Mead
species.description: A great dark bee with a ruff of gold, said to visit a meadow once a summer.

species.name: Crumb
species.description: A grey mouse that knows every gap under every door.

species.name: Glint
species.description: A pale, thick-bodied fish from meltwater pools under the ice.

species.name: Lotus
species.description: A turtle with a shell like carved jade, older than the marsh it swims in.

species.name: Flicker
species.description: A dusty moth that circles porch lights and street lamps.

species.name: Lumen
species.description: An amber jelly that lights the dark water under the mangrove roots.

species.name: Skip
species.description: A hopping desert mouse with a tufted tail longer than itself.

species.name: Silt
species.description: A blunt, mud-coloured goby that rests on its fins in the tidal channels.

species.name: Halcyon
species.description: A kingfisher of teal and flame that dives where the tide turns.

species.name: Noodle
species.description: A spotted eel that threads between reed stems.

species.name: Fern
species.description: A dark, slow newt with an orange belly, found under wet leaves.

species.name: Dawdle
species.description: A banded snail that climbs grass stems after rain.

species.name: Bracken
species.description: A plump vole that keeps runways through the long grass.

species.name: Petal
species.description: A plain white butterfly, the first one out on a warm morning.

species.name: Bloop
species.description: A pale jelly that pulses along just under the surface.

species.name: Lichen
species.description: A small green beetle speckled like the lichen it lives on.

species.name: Bramble
species.description: A stag beetle whose shell is dotted with moss that glows after rain.

species.name: Skitter
species.description: A mud-brown crab that sidles between the roots at low tide.

species.name: Murk
species.description: A dark ray that lies buried in the silt with only its eyes showing.

species.name: Signal
species.description: A dragonfly banded in pink light, seen over wet streets under the signs.

species.name: Sable
species.description: A dusk-purple moth whose wing-eyes glow among the dark leaves.

species.name: Nimbus
species.description: A white fox whose tail tip glows like the sky it walks under.

species.name: Fiddle
species.description: A blue crab that waves one huge orange claw from the mouth of its burrow.

species.name: Puddle
species.description: A green frog that plops into the water before you see it.

species.name: Tango
species.description: A plump orange fish from park ponds and garden pools.

species.name: Dart
species.description: A blue dragonfly that patrols the same stretch of bank all day.

species.name: Tumble
species.description: A green turtle that basks on logs and slips in at the first footstep.

species.name: Nib
species.description: A yellow-green seahorse that holds on to weed with its tail.

species.name: Flint
species.description: A sand-coloured scorpion that waits under flat stones through the heat.

species.name: Copper
species.description: A copper gecko that hunts moths on warm walls after dark.

species.name: Zephyr
species.description: A red dragonfly with marked wing tips that holds the best perch on the marsh.

species.name: Grit
species.description: A flat, pale lizard that all but vanishes against the sand.

species.name: Pebble
species.description: A slim sandy minnow that shoals in the shallows.

species.name: Flurry
species.description: A round white bird that rides the wind over the snowfields.

species.name: Drift
species.description: A thick-furred white moth that flies on still, cold days.

species.name: Mitten
species.description: A white hare with broad furred feet that runs on top of the snow.

species.name: Skim
species.description: A sandy ray that glides low over the bottom.

species.name: Button
species.description: A round red beetle with black spots that keeps the greenfly down.

species.name: Nocturne
species.description: A midnight-blue ray scattered with lights like a clear night sky.

species.name: Cobble
species.description: A grey pigeon at home on ledges, statues and station roofs.

species.name: Sol
species.description: A horned scarab of polished gold that walks the dunes at noon.

species.name: Marigold
species.description: A lizard that opens a blazing frill round its neck when the noon sun is highest.

species.name: Quill
species.description: A round hedgehog that snuffles under gorse and rolls up when surprised.

species.name: Thistle
species.description: A rose-red seahorse with a spiny back and a tall crown.

species.name: Bog
species.description: A round, short-tailed lemming that tunnels through the moss.

species.name: Plum
species.description: A deep purple fish with a fanned tail, found over clear gravel.

species.name: Acorn
species.description: A big-eared mouse that hoards seeds under the roots.
